verdict.rationale: The evidence shows ByteAsk can manage multiple agent sessions: /agents groups them into needs-input, working, ready and finished, and each run presents a diff. Nothing documents launching several attempts of the same task in parallel, comparing their results side by side, or picking one to apply. Session management is an adjacent feature, not the best-of-N attempt workflow this story asks for.

support.subject: As a developer, I can run several task attempts in parallel and compare results before choosing one
